title: For Loops and range: FizzBuzz
learning_objectives: Loop a known number of times with for and range
Loop over the characters of a string
hints: `for i in range(1, n + 1):` includes n.
Check `i % 15 == 0` (or `i % 3 == 0 and i % 5 == 0`) before the single cases.
Add to `total` inside `if i % 3 == 0 or i % 5 == 0:`.

failure_feedback.advice: Test divisibility by both 3 and 5 before testing 3 alone.
Use `range(1, n + 1)` so n itself is included.
With n = 0 the loop runs zero times; only the sum line is printed.
Add i to the total when it is divisible by 3 **or** 5.
